pauses.reason: hospitality (Marcela's family)
pauses.zh_reason: 受 Marcela 家人款待

pauses.reason: visa overstay (paid US$100 for new visa); money wired from home
pauses.zh_reason: 簽證逾期（付 100 美元辦新簽證）；家裡匯錢過來

pauses.reason: unknown - journal pages missing
pauses.zh_reason: 原因不明：日誌頁面遺失，離開日期未記錄

pauses.reason: rest (approximate dates)
pauses.zh_reason: 休息（日期為近似）

pauses.reason: rest ~2.5 weeks; collected Western Union money
pauses.zh_reason: 休息約兩週半；領取 Western Union 匯款

pauses.reason: rest; personal visit; visa problems
pauses.left_how: Offroute: bus Arica -> Tocopilla and tanker-truck ride back (visit to Tamara); hitched 18 km to the border for visa, bus to Chilean consulate in Tacna, transport back to Arica. Cart left in Arica; resumed walking from Arica 15 Nov.
pauses.zh_reason: 休息、探訪友人、處理簽證（搭車往返托科皮亞與塔克納；拖車留在阿里卡）

pauses.reason: rest during town festival
pauses.zh_reason: 鎮上節慶期間休息

pauses.reason: funding (money problems), Christmas/New Year; paid modelling jobs
pauses.left_how: none during stay; left by walking then truck lift (see segment)
pauses.zh_reason: 缺錢；過聖誕與新年；接付費模特兒工作

pauses.reason: funding - waiting for Western Union money from mother; illness
pauses.zh_reason: 等母親的 Western Union 匯款；生病

pauses.reason: visa (expired ~11 Feb; only 7-day extension granted)
pauses.zh_reason: 簽證問題（約 2 月 11 日到期，只獲延期 7 天）

pauses.reason: money and mail
pauses.zh_reason: 等匯款與郵件

pauses.reason: rest with host Roberto
pauses.zh_reason: 住在接待者 Roberto 家休息

pauses.reason: health (anaemia diagnosed); personal
pauses.left_how: Offroute Holy-week trip Chiclayo -> Trujillo by truck and bus, back by car and bus (approx. 20 Apr - inference)
pauses.zh_reason: 健康（診斷出貧血）與私人事務；聖週搭車往返特魯希略

pauses.reason: funding - waiting for money
pauses.zh_reason: 等匯款

pauses.reason: girlfriend Treiz visited (flew in/out of Piura); bought donkey
pauses.left_how: unknown whether any movement Piura<->Sullana by vehicle
pauses.zh_reason: 女友 Treiz 來訪；買了一頭驢子

pauses.reason: visa (Loja immigration refused; 4-day stamp)
pauses.left_how: Offroute bus Loja -> Macara border (paid Peruvian police US$20, got 2-month Ecuador visa) and night bus back (~20-23 Jun, exact date unknown); taxi trip to Vilcabamba
pauses.zh_reason: 簽證（洛哈移民局拒絕，只給 4 天章；搭巴士到馬卡拉邊境辦得兩個月簽證）

pauses.reason: rest
pauses.zh_reason: 休息

pauses.reason: funding (money had not arrived) and hospitality of cousin's in-laws; robbed in Quito bar fight 11 Aug (journals stolen)
pauses.left_how: Driven from Quito to San Antonio 23 Jul; later walked the gap on foot (see segments)
pauses.zh_reason: 錢沒到，借住表親姻親家；8 月 11 日在基多酒吧打架中被搶、日誌被偷

pauses.reason: rest; sent bags by bus to Cali
pauses.zh_reason: 休息；把行李用巴士寄往卡利

pauses.reason: rest
pauses.left_how: Stayed at Galia's house in the hills above Cali (offroute); 16 Oct bus back into Cali centre and resumed walking from there
pauses.zh_reason: 休息（住在卡利城外山上 Galia 家）

pauses.reason: Darien planning; waiting for end of wet season; funding ('my money had run out, but luckily mother had collected more'); waiting for GPS
pauses.left_how: Trips to Catty's family farm east of Medellin (offroute, local)
pauses.zh_reason: 規劃達連隘口路線；等雨季結束；等資金（錢用完了，幸好母親又募到一些）；等 GPS

pauses.reason: rest/preparation at army post
pauses.zh_reason: 在陸軍據點休息、準備

pauses.reason: detention - entered Panama without visa or Colombian exit stamp (18 days in custody: Boca de Cupe, Meteti cells, La Palma prison)
pauses.left_how: Police helicopter/truck/boat while in custody; after release 5 Mar returned by boat, minibus, lifts and boats to Boca de Cupe (arrived ~12:30, 7 Mar); restarted 8 Mar
pauses.zh_reason: 無巴拿馬簽證與哥倫比亞出境章入境而被拘留 18 天（博卡德庫佩、梅特蒂拘留室、拉帕爾馬監獄）

pauses.reason: funding (no money), depression, resupply of equipment via British Embassy; girlfriend Catty visited
pauses.zh_reason: 沒錢、情緒低落；透過英國大使館補給裝備；女友 Catty 來訪

pauses.reason: short rest
pauses.zh_reason: 短暫休息

pauses.reason: Rest/resupply in Panama City after Darién Gap (handover from leg 01; how he reached Panama City is leg-01 scope)
pauses.zh_reason: 穿越達連隘口後在巴拿馬城休整補給（與第 01 段交接；他如何到達巴拿馬城屬第 01 段範圍）

pauses.reason: Trying to have a new trailer built in León; length of stop unknown ('after the stop in Leon')
pauses.zh_reason: 在 León 設法請人打造新拖車；停留多久不明

pauses.reason: US visa (90-day waiver) expired; must apply abroad
pauses.left_how: Flew to Bogotá, Colombia, returned to Las Vegas (Wikipedia, citing Arizona Daily Star – not verified by me). Exact resume point unknown
pauses.zh_reason: 美國 90 天免簽到期，必須出境申請；據 Wikipedia（未經查證）飛往波哥大後回到拉斯維加斯，確切恢復地點不明

pauses.reason: Cart B2 and equipment stolen at Exit 379 bar; replacement trailer built in Helena
pauses.left_how: Lifts to Conrad, Tracy (Great Falls) and Helena, MT; driven back to Exit 379 by Ruth Finch
pauses.zh_reason: 推車 B2 和裝備在第 379 號出口的酒吧被偷，在 Helena 打造替代拖車

pauses.reason: Meet father Keith & stepbrother Ben in Calgary for resupply/BBC filming
pauses.left_how: Bill Anderson's pick-up to Calgary; father's hired pick-up back to truck stop
pauses.zh_reason: 到卡加利與父親 Keith 和繼兄弟 Ben 會合，補給並配合 BBC 拍攝

pauses.reason: Prolonged stay in Calgary while supporters fought Canadian immigration over partner Catalina (Catty) Estrada's visitor visa (refused)
pauses.zh_reason: 在卡加利長期停留，支持者與加拿大移民局交涉伴侶 Catalina（Catty）Estrada 的訪客簽證（遭拒）

pauses.reason: Stay at Fort Nelson; reason not stated in extracts ('Leaving Fort Nelson was not meant to be like this. It was intended to be a far happier day')
pauses.zh_reason: 在 Fort Nelson 停留，日誌摘錄未說明原因（「離開 Fort Nelson 本不該是這樣」）

pauses.reason: Rest/media in Whitehorse
pauses.zh_reason: 在白馬市休息、接受媒體採訪，約一週

pauses.reason: Waited in Fairbanks for winter freeze to travel west on snow-machine trails / frozen rivers (reason inferred; not explicitly stated)
pauses.left_how: unknown; journal starts again at Murphy Dome 16 Dec 2004
pauses.zh_reason: 在費爾班克斯等冬季結冰，以便走雪上摩托車道和冰封河道往西（原因為推論，資料未明說）

pauses.reason: Spring melt ended the 2005 season; US visa expiring; teeth repair
pauses.left_how: Flew Unalakleet→Nome→Fairbanks, then to Colombia; returned to Alaska early Oct 2005; Anchorage/Fairbanks preparation; flew back to Unalakleet
pauses.zh_reason: 春季融冰結束 2005 年行程，美國簽證將到期，另需修補牙齒

pauses.reason: Waiting at Teller for Dimitri (frostbite check in Nome)
pauses.zh_reason: 在 Teller 等 Dimitri（他在 Nome 檢查凍傷）

pauses.reason: Preparation in Wales school; waiting for ice window
pauses.zh_reason: 在 Wales 的學校準備，等待海冰時機

pauses.reason: Detention for illegal border crossing; court in Chukotka ordered fine + deportation (≈14 Apr 2006), overturned on appeal (announced 5 May 2006); then permits for Chukotka
pauses.left_how: Moved by border guards to Lavrentiya; flight Russia→Nome 24 May 2006; then flew to Colombia for summer 2006
pauses.zh_reason: 因非法越境被拘留；楚科奇法院約 4 月 14 日判罰款並驅逐出境，上訴推翻（5 月 5 日宣布）；之後辦理楚科奇許可證

pauses.reason: court case (fine + expulsion 14 Apr 2006, overturned on appeal 5 May 2006), then Chukotka permit delays
pauses.left_how: returned to Alaska; '58 days' in Russia
pauses.zh_reason: 官司（2006 年 4 月 14 日判罰款並驅逐，5 月 5 日上訴撤銷），之後等楚科奇許可證

pauses.reason: permit only valid two months (agent error)
pauses.left_how: flight to Alaska; lectures in Vancouver/Seattle/Anchorage July 2007; returned Nome->Anadyr 15 Aug 2007
pauses.zh_reason: 許可證只有兩個月有效（代辦人的失誤）

pauses.reason: permit/visa expiry, needed new passport, 1-year visa, 6-month Chukotka permit
pauses.left_how: Kinross helicopter/convoy out of Dvoynoye; flight Anadyr 13 Dec 2007 -> Fairbanks
pauses.zh_reason: 許可證／簽證到期，需要換新護照、辦一年簽證與六個月的楚科奇許可證

pauses.reason: spring thaw + 90-day visa limit, then lost sponsors (2008 crisis) and visa/permit problems
pauses.left_how: via Anadyr to Nome (26 May 2008); Fairbanks; Mexico (Melaque) from Aug 2008 to 2010
pauses.zh_reason: 春季融雪加上 90 天簽證限制，之後因 2008 年金融危機失去贊助，又遇簽證／許可證問題

pauses.reason: season end, 2012 visa refusal, five-year entry ban (lifted 23 Oct 2014)
pauses.left_how: flew Yakutsk -> Moscow -> Los Angeles (4 May 2011)
pauses.zh_reason: 季節結束，2012 年簽證被拒，隨後五年禁止入境（2014 年 10 月 23 日解除）

pauses.reason: 90-day visa limit; looking for a summer route
pauses.zh_reason: 90 天簽證限制；正在找夏季路線（起訖日期不明，約 2015 年 5 月底／6 月開始）

pauses.reason: police detention in Xinjiang; British Embassy intervention (duration not stated)
pauses.left_how: did not leave route; refused vehicle transport
pauses.zh_reason: 在新疆遭警察扣留，英國大使館介入（扣留多久沒有記載）；他沒有離開路線，並拒絕搭車。

pauses.reason: severe heatstroke, hospitalised several days (Uzbekistan; location not stated)
pauses.zh_reason: 嚴重中暑，住院數天（在烏茲別克，地點未記載）。

pauses.reason: Iran visa refused (British passport, US sanctions on sponsors), Soleimani killing (Jan 2020) collapsed contacts, COVID-19 from spring 2020, Turkmenistan closed borders, Russia route closed by 2022 invasion of Ukraine; Plan C Caspian adopted Feb 2022. Resumed NOT at the Iran border but at Bukhara (backtrack).
pauses.left_how: Escorted to Ashgabat and flown out to Los Angeles; then waited in Mexico; flew Mexico → Tashkent 2023, train to Bukhara
pauses.zh_reason: 伊朗拒發簽證（英國護照，美國制裁使贊助者無法協助）、2020 年 1 月蘇萊曼尼遇刺使聯絡管道瓦解、2020 年春起 COVID-19、土庫曼封鎖邊境、俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭使俄國路線關閉；2022 年 2 月改採游過裏海的 C 計畫，最後不是從伊朗邊境、而是退回布哈拉重新起步。

pauses.reason: visa renewal (had to leave Uzbekistan); used to visit Baku re support boat
pauses.left_how: unknown (travel to Baku; mode not stated)
pauses.zh_reason: 必須離開烏茲別克續簽證，順道去巴庫洽談支援船。

pauses.reason: rest, resupply, equipment repair
pauses.zh_reason: 休息、補給、修理裝備。

pauses.reason: 30-day Kazakh visa renewal ('visa bounce'); support-boat safety requirements unmet, swim postponed from 2023 to Aug 2024 (cold-water concern)
pauses.zh_reason: 出境再入境以更新 30 天哈薩克簽證；支援船未達安全要求，游泳從 2023 年延到 2024 年 8 月（擔心水溫太低）。

pauses.reason: waiting for swim logistics/permits; team moved back to Baku 1 Jun 2024 to work with Azerbaijani government; trained in Baku (Jul) and Aktau (Aug)
pauses.zh_reason: 等待游泳的後勤與許可；2024 年 6 月 1 日團隊回到巴庫與亞塞拜然政府合作，7 月在巴庫、8 月在 Aktau 訓練。

pauses.end: 2025-08 (returned to Istanbul ~19 Aug 2025; resumed walking ~21 Aug 2025)
pauses.reason: Turkish 90-day stay expiring; needed ~90 days outside Turkey before re-entry
pauses.left_how: Left Istanbul same day; waited in Mexico (BBC 11 Jun 2025, Explorersweb). Wikipedia says Armenia — see conflicts. Mode of travel (presumably flight) not stated.
pauses.zh_reason: 土耳其 90 天停留期限快到，須在境外待約 90 天才能再入境（他在墨西哥等待；Wikipedia 說是亞美尼亞，與其引用的 BBC 報導不符）

pauses.reason: Schengen 90/180-day limit
pauses.left_how: Returned to Mexico ('Speaking from Mexico, where he retreats every few months in order to satisfy visa requirements'); travel mode not stated
pauses.zh_reason: 申根區 90/180 天停留限制（回墨西哥等待）

pauses.reason: Schengen visa limit; also awaiting Channel-crossing permissions
pauses.left_how: Returned to Mexico per Wikipedia (not confirmed in the BBC articles it cites)
pauses.zh_reason: 申根停留期限到了，同時在等待橫渡海峽的許可（Wikipedia 說他回墨西哥，但它引用的 BBC 報導沒有證實）

pauses.reason: Overnight rest on support boat between swim sessions; restarted each morning from last position
pauses.left_how: Support boat (does not count as progress)
pauses.zh_reason: 游泳期間每晚在支援船上休息，隔天早上從前一天的位置繼續游

pauses.reason: Rest in Dover after swim (media, fish & chips)
pauses.left_how: Stayed in Dover (no off-route travel reported)
pauses.zh_reason: 上岸後在多佛休息（接受媒體採訪、吃了 28 年來第一份炸魚薯條）

02:S25.title: Karl Bushby (Wikipedia, raw wikitext)
02:S25.quote: On 29 April 2002, Bushby left Mexico and entered the United States at Nogales, Arizona. Upon reaching Las Vegas in July, Bushby was told that his 90-day visa had expired and could not be renewed while he was in the United States. He thus flew back to Bogotá to apply for a six-month visa, returning to Las Vegas to resume the walk when his visa was approved in August. On New Year's Day 2003, a day away from crossing into Canada, Bushby's handcart was stolen while he was visiting a bar in Toole County, Montana. ... Between 17 and 31 March 2006, Bushby and French adventurer Dimitri Kieffer successfully crossed the Bering Strait on foot, having to take a roundabout 14-day route across a frozen 150-mile section to cross the 58-mile wide strait ... detained by Russian border troop officers while they were crossing the Russian border near the Chukotkan village of Uelen ... It was announced on 5 May 2006 that the Russian appeal court had upheld Bushby's application

03:S7.title: Английский путешественник застрянет на Колыме (Алексей Курило)
03:S7.quote: В 2008 году Карл Бушби прервал своё путешествие по Чукотке в городе Билибино из-за распутицы. Продолжить свой маршрут смог 25 февраля года нынешнего, прилетев чартерным рейсом из Нома (Аляска) в Анадырь. Добравшись также с помощью авиации до Билибино, он 10 марта отправился в село Анюйск. Эта трёхсоткилометровая дорога заняла у него 10 дней. 22 марта он вышел из этого чукотского села в направлении посёлка Черский ... На Стадухинской протоке путешественника встретили военнослужащие пограничного поста «Черский». Проверив документы, они выяснили, что у него нет разрешения на пребывание в Нижнеколымском районе, что и было оформлено в виде протокола. ... Следующая остановка странника будет в селе Колымское. Затем его маршрут пройдёт через Андрюшкино, Аргахтах, Среднеколымск, Зырянку, а далее - на Якутск

03:S33.title: Goliath Expedition home page – '16 March 2007' update
03:S33.quote: At last we are able to report that Karl is back in Russia ... They will make their way back to Uelen in order that Karl can continue the walk from the point it left off.

03:S34.title: Karl and Dimitri finally arrived in Uelen! (Goliath Expedition MediaBlog)
03:S34.quote: After a 10 hour ride in an all-terrain vehicle Karl and Dimitri finally arrived in Uelen on 12th April. ... Heading north-west along the northern coast of the Chukotskiy Peninsula they passed through the villages of Inchoun and Enurmino ... before arriving at the village of Neshkan on 24th April, some 193 kms / 119 miles from Uelen. ... They stayed in Neshkan until 27th April ... They are now heading inland, westwards, towards Amguema, approx 287 kms / 177 miles.

03:S35.title: Karl and Dmitri won’t be walking together (MediaBlog)
03:S35.quote: They have both reached Anguema (approximately 480 kilometres / 296 miles from Uelen) and will walk down to Egvekinot. ... Karl believes that at Egvekinot he will have to send his sled and most of his equipment down to Anadyr to be stored there

03:S36.title: Permits procedure to start all over again (MediaBlog)
03:S36.quote: the agent (with a choice of two months or six months permits) chose the lesser. This means that K and D will have to leave Russia by the end of this month. ... Given the availability of aircraft, Karl will probably return to Alaska on 21st May.

03:S37.title: Karl back in Anadyr (MediaBlog)
03:S37.quote: On the 15th August, after several days waiting in Nome, Karl managed to get on a flight back to Anadyr in Russia. ... waiting for the next flight up to Egvekinot. This being the town he reached on the last phase of the trek

03:S38.title: Karl in Anguema (MediaBlog)
03:S38.quote: By the 28th August, Karl will have made his way to Anguema, a small village north of Egvekinot, by a series of boat trips and flights. As Karl is taking a more northerly summer route for the present, it will be easier to start at Anguema. Being a village he passed through on the last leg, he can start there without breaking the expedition’s golden rule, (no advancement of the actual expedition route by any other means than walking / swimming).

03:S39.title: Straight from Karl (MediaBlog)
03:S39.quote: Just let you all know that I reached my first way-point, the mining camp, on schedule on 9th September. ... This first 200km is just a warm-up though. I’ve been looking at the best options for the next move up to Komsomolskiy, (474km). ... Everyone in Egvekinot and Amguema has been extremely helpful and the truckers on route have dropped off food for me as they passed.

03:S40.title: Goliath Expedition home page – '10 October 2007' update
03:S40.quote: On Saturday, 6th October, Karl arrived at Komsomolskiy after walking the 474 km / 295 miles from his last waypoint at the Valinistiy mining camp. The track created for the mining trucks had been a lot better than expected ... He has now moved up to Pevek to pick up supplies that he'd sent ahead.

03:S41.title: Karl heads to Bilibino (MediaBlog)
03:S41.quote: It’s believed that Karl left Pevek / Komsomolskiy on Sunday 28th October after the start being delayed for a number of days because of bad storms. The next leg will take him 500km to the town of Bilibino.

03:S42.title: Karl depleted of food and gas (MediaBlog, Karl's own text)
03:S42.quote: I found camp Dvoynoye having depleted all my gas and food. ... Yes, I’d have liked to have made it to Bilibino but in the grand scheme of things I guess I can suck it up. I was beaten up pretty badly the first day out of Komsomolskiy. ... With a good sled, the equipment and right time of year I can make, Bilibino in 5 or 6 days.

03:S43.title: Goliath Expedition home page – '19 December 2007' update
03:S43.quote: Karl managed to get a flight from Chukotka (Anadyr) on the 13th December, having spent a month making his way back from the furthest point along his route west (Dvoynoye mining camp).

03:S44.title: Karl back in Russia (MediaBlog)
03:S44.quote: Karl returned to Russia on 16th April 2008 and by the end of April, using various means, he had made his way to the Dvoynoye mining camp and the start of the new walking phase. ... by the time he got to Bilibno on 18th May, Karl was dragging the sled over dirt. Consequently, there was no chance of getting it to Cherskiy. ... he had to make the return journey to Anadyr and then the US, arriving in Nome on 26th May.

03:S45.title: Goliath Expedition home page – '12 May 2008' update
03:S45.quote: Karl had made it up to Pevek by 30th April. He managed to get a lift on one of the last vehicles taking the ‘winter road’ before it closed. This took him back to the mining camp at Dvoynoye, his starting point for the next leg.

03:S46.title: Goliath Expedition home page – '19 August 2008' update
03:S46.quote: Karl will also been making his way to Mexico before the end of August, when his US visa will expire. He will probably remain there for some time before eventually returning to Alaska and then Russia at the start of the winter.

04:S2.title: Goliath Expedition Story & Route
04:S2.quote: Back across Russia and into Mongolia, Karl arrived in Ulaanbaatar on 8 August 2017. ... A training camp west of the capital spent five months preparing the animals ... Just before winter, the caravan set out and covered more than a thousand kilometres across the unforgiving steppe. ... The caravan dissolved. Karl left it behind and crossed into China alone. | In 2018, Karl crossed into China ... The police let him keep walking — under a strictly mandated route, a twenty-four-hour escort, no camping, and later no internet access — all the way to the Kazakh border. | Across the Kazakh border, Karl met up with Rika in Almaty before pressing west. ... Karl and Rika followed the Silk Road through Samarkand and the old trading hub of Bukhara, heading toward Turkmenistan. ... At the Turkmenistan border, visa restrictions forced a separation: Karl crossed alone. | Supported by two escort vessels — a local support boat from the Kazakh port of Aktau and an Azerbaijani Coast Guard ship ... They pushed forward in six-to-nine-hour shifts ... After thirty-one days at sea, 288 kilometres ... and more than 132 hours in the water, the team stepped ashore in Azerbaijan

04:S3.title: Hiking the World: Updates from the Road
04:S3.quote: But back in late 2017, a number of notable long-distance travelers elected to join forces in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. ... Bushby, Maxwell and Ramsay have all left the project, leaving Norjmaa to continue alone.

05:S39.title: Karl Bushby 48 hours from completing 28-year walk to Hull
05:S39.publisher: Brit Brief (apparently rewriting ITV News 31 Oct 2026: https://www.itv.com/news/2026-10-31/adventurer-karl-bushby-48-hours-away-from-completing-epic-28-year-journey, which timed out)
05:S39.quote: travelling near Barton in South Cambridgeshire ... about 130 miles left to go until he can complete his epic 31,000 mile (50,000km) walk (spokesperson) ... final stop ... at Queen Victoria Square ... at 11am on Monday, 2 November

05:S40.title: Karl Bushby embraces his mother as he completes his 28-year walk around world
05:S40.publisher: Associated Press (Brian Melley, Jon Super), via PBS NewsHour
05:S40.quote: pushed his cart toward a hero's welcome at City Hall before setting off for the last stretch to see his mother

05:S41.title: Karl Bushby completes 28-year, 31,000-mile walk around world
05:S41.quote: hundreds of people cheered his arrival at City Hall ... push his two-wheeled cart the final steps across Hull and reunite with his mother

05:S42.title: British adventurer Karl Bushby returns home after 28-year walk around world
05:S42.quote: outside her terraced house, in his home city of Hull

05:S43.title: Karl Bushby 'overwhelmed' at Humber Bridge welcome
05:S43.publisher: BBC News (Emma Petrie), syndicated on AOL
05:S43.quote: crossed the Humber Bridge through thick mist on the final leg ... He will set off from Hessle and walk to Queen Victoria Square

05:S44.title: Karl Bushby: Hull City welcome adventurer home after 28-year trek from Chile
05:S44.quote: He made his final stop at Queen Victoria Square in the city centre before returning to his mother's house.

claims.value: Journal: first move of ~20 yards on the night of 31 Oct/1 Nov ending in wheel failure; repairs 1 Nov; 'finally underway at 10:36' on Monday 2 Nov 1998

conflicts.assessment: Not truly contradictory: 1 Nov 1998 is the official start ('Day one'), but the first sustained walking day was 2 Nov 1998. Map should use 1 Nov for the start event and note 2 Nov as first walking day.

conflicts.topic: Where the 18 days of Panama detention were served

claims.value: 'he spent 18 days in a jail in Meteti'
Held at Boca de Cupe 16-20 Feb, Meteti cells 20-23 Feb, La Palma prison 23 Feb-5 Mar 2001
Boca de Cupe until 20 Feb, then Meteti, 18 days total in police custody, released via La Palma immigration

conflicts.assessment: Primary sources agree on 18 days but spread over three places; most of it at La Palma. Wikipedia's 'jail in Meteti' is a simplification. Wikipedia cites Giant Steps (S32), which we could not read.

claims.value: Route 'through Argentina, Peru, Ecuador, and Colombia' (Chile omitted)
Chile journals 12 Mar-15 Nov 1999 (Osorno to Arica) plus Punta Arenas region Nov 1998

conflicts.assessment: Wikipedia omits Chile; journals show ~8 months walking the length of Chile. Use journals.

claims.value: 6,671 miles from Punta Arenas on arrival 16 Mar 2001

conflicts.assessment: Single source only; not independently confirmed. Journal running totals: ~1370 mi Osorno, 2740 mi Antofagasta, 3080 mi Iquique, 5010 mi Cuenca, 5,680 mi Cali.

claims.value: '70 minutes 23 degrees west, 23 degrees 50 minutes south' after leaving Antofagasta northbound

conflicts.assessment: 23°50'S is south of Antofagasta (23°39'S) while the Tropic is 23°26'S north of the city; the grid is garbled. Kept as reported but flagged.

claims.value: 3 Jun 2000 '70 degrees 50 minutes west' at Peru/Ecuador river

conflicts.assessment: Evident typing slips; 21 Dec omitted, others kept/flagged or replaced with approximate_region.

claims.value: Wales / Cape Prince of Wales, 17 Mar 2006

conflicts.assessment: Wales is supported by Karl's own diary; Nome in S21 is an error (Nome was where they met / Evergreen base).
Diary: left 17 Mar, landfall 31 Mar = 14 days (15 calendar days inclusive). Both counts consistent with same dates.

conflicts.topic: Date of arrival in Russia / Uelen

claims.value: Landfall 31 Mar 2006, walked to Uelen same day
March 31 website post placed them in Uelen

conflicts.assessment: Primary diary gives 31 Mar landfall. BBC's '2 April' may refer to formal registration or be an error. Detention date 1 Apr (AP) plausible but unconfirmed by primary source.

conflicts.topic: Strait width and distance actually travelled
conflicts.assessment: Different journalistic figures; no GPS track published. Treat as approximate.

claims.value: Swam an open lead 'hundreds of metres wide' on day 1; frequent immersion in broken ice
'swim five days through the slushy ice'
'14 days, 5 days where swimming was required'

conflicts.assessment: Swimming confirmed by primary source; the '5 days' figure comes only from Kieffer-related/secondary sources; diary extracts only explicitly describe the day-1 swim (extracts skip several days).

claims.value: 'They drifted for 36 hours until rescued by a helicopter' (presented within crossing story)
Drift and Evergreen helicopter lift occurred 3–5 Feb 2006 off Cape Douglas (28 mi SE of King Island), before the crossing

conflicts.assessment: S21 conflates the February pre-crossing incident with the March crossing; no helicopter rescue during the crossing itself per diary.

claims.value: reported themselves to Border Guard in Uelen
detained while crossing the Russian border near Uelen
stopped in the village of Lavrenty
detained by border guards and moved to Lavrentiya

conflicts.assessment: Best reading: presented themselves in Uelen, then moved to Lavrentiya and held there under movement restriction (stayed with priest Father Leonid).

claims.value: £40 fine upheld, expulsion cancelled on appeal
Russian appeal court upheld Bushby's application, 5 May 2006

conflicts.assessment: Consistent: lower court (≈14 Apr 2006) fine + deportation; appeal (announced 5 May 2006) kept fine, cancelled deportation. They left Russia by flight 24 May 2006 (S21) – a departure, not a deportation. Some later secondary pieces say 'deported' – not supported.
Probably dual French/US citizen, Anchorage/Seattle-based.
Karl's own diary (24 Mar) preferred, but both are expedition-official.

claims.value: Reached Las Vegas in July 2002, flew to Bogotá, resumed in Las Vegas August 2002

conflicts.assessment: Journal extracts show Searchlight 25 Jun and Overton 19 Aug 2002 with nothing in between; consistent but exact break/resume point unverified (Wikipedia cites Arizona Daily Star clippings that I could not access).

claims.value: 'Karl is back in Russia' posted 16 Mar 2007

conflicts.assessment: Primary site confirms in Russia by 16 Mar; S5's '19 March' likely the date of official entry/report. Walking restart is firmly 12–13 Apr 2007 (S34).

claims.value: Both reached Amguema (~480 km) and 'will walk down to Egvekinot'
Egvekinot 'the town he reached on the last phase'

conflicts.assessment: Consistent: Uelen->Amguema ~480 km + Amguema->Egvekinot ~ 90 km ≈ 350–400 mi. Restart was at Amguema (S38), so Amguema->Egvekinot is a spur.

claims.value: Plan: Uelen -> Egvekinot -> Anadyr -> Markovo -> Magadan
Actual: Uelen -> north coast -> Amguema -> mining camp -> Komsomolsky -> Dvoynoye -> Bilibino

conflicts.assessment: Route changed because of the late start and the 2-month permit ('yet another change of route which will probably be to the north', S36). Use actual.

claims.value: 'returning to Alaska when his visa ran out in November'
Reached Dvoynoye ~Nov; flew out of Anadyr 13 Dec 2007

conflicts.assessment: Walking ended Nov 2007; left Russia 13 Dec 2007.

conflicts.topic: Date and cause of the post-2011 entry ban

claims.value: Barred five years after straying into a security zone in spring 2011 (written July 2012)
March 2013: banned five years 'because of a border violation last year'
2013 ban for closed zone in Yakutia

conflicts.assessment: Visa refusal April 2012 (primary). Five-year ban known by 2012 per US sources, reported in UK March 2013. Trigger is almost certainly the March 2011 Nizhnekolymsky permit protocol (S7); HDM's 'last year' is probably loose.

conflicts.topic: Dates of the LA -> Washington walk
conflicts.assessment: Sept 2013 – ~Sept 2014 is well supported; 2015 is the year of the Outside article/documentary coverage, not the walk.
Off-route; ~3,000–3,600 mi.
Unsupported by any contemporaneous source; treat as error.

claims.value: Met 'shortly before Yakutsk' on Lena highway (entry 24 Jun 2016)

conflicts.assessment: Incompatible; S28 entries are internally impossible (Irkutsk 23 Jun, Yakutsk 24 Jun). Do not use S28 for positioning.

claims.value: Mogocha photo then Erofey Pavlovich geotag ~5 Dec 2016

conflicts.assessment: Westbound he should pass Erofey Pavlovich first; posts may be out of order. Unresolved.
Not location-relevant.

claims.value: 16 Aug 2024 Karl: leaving 'south to the start point'; finish 17 Sep 2024 18:30 after 31 days
WBH Jun 2024: start date set for August 10th
August 2024 (YouTube title 'Caspian Sea Crossing August 2024 WBH')

conflicts.assessment: October is wrong: Karl's own post dates completion 17 Sep 2024 and Azerbaijani press reported the arrival 17 Sep 2024. Explorersweb's first article was published 19 Oct 2024, which likely caused the 'October' error. Start ≈ 16–18 Aug 2024 (exact first-stroke day unconfirmed).
Prefer Karl's 31 days (primary). 41 days may count from team arrival on the Kazakh coast (~7–10 Aug); unverified.
288 km is the headline figure in Karl's own later posts; 275.5 km may be swum distance vs straight-line/total. Unresolved.

claims.value: Met 'In the resort city of Sea Breeze'

conflicts.assessment: Consistent: Sea Breeze (Nardaran, Absheron) lies within Baku's administrative area. Precise beach coordinates not published. Sea Breeze/idman also say 'border to border', leaving open whether the counted swim ended at the coast or at a maritime boundary.

claims.value: Azeri Coast Guard and a 64-meter ship
a local support boat from Aktau and an Azerbaijani Coast Guard ship
a warship and two regular vessels

conflicts.assessment: Probably compatible (coast guard warship + 1–2 civilian boats). No vessel names found.

claims.value: 3 h morning + 3 h afternoon, sleeping on boats
plan ~10 km/day, 5 km before and 5 km after lunch

conflicts.assessment: Likely varied with weather; no source describes GPS marking/resume method.

claims.value: Norjmaa: Karl stopped after about three days (search-snippet only, from theubposts.com; not fetched)

conflicts.assessment: Karl-side sources agree on ~1,000+ km. Norjmaa's claim unverified; recorded for completeness.

claims.value: 'In 2018, he crossed Kazakhstan and then made his way through Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan'
'5 years after entering Eastern Kazakhstan' (said Aug 2024 → ~2019)
Uzbekistan entry early June 2019 (unsourced Wikipedia edit) / leaving Almaty listed under July 2019

conflicts.assessment: China→Kazakhstan crossing is late 2018 or early 2019; unresolved.

claims.value: 'arrived at the Iranian border on September 15' (El Informador, Feb 2020)
'By the end of 2019 I arrived on the border of Iran'
'By the end of 2019, he had trekked through Turkmenistan to its border with Iran'

conflicts.assessment: Most likely late Aug–mid Sep 2019; 'end of 2019' is loose wording.

claims.value: Siberia, Mongolia, China, then Turkmenistan and Kazakhstan
'returned to Kazakhstan to head north through Russia and Ukraine' / returned to Latin America

conflicts.assessment: Karl's own site and WBH give China → Kazakhstan (Almaty) → Uzbekistan (Samarkand, Bukhara) → Turkmenistan. Otello.ru account is garbled.

claims.value: Post dated '12/03/2023': everything arrives in Bukhara; 'Hitting the road 14/03/2023'

conflicts.assessment: Internal inconsistency; arrival in Tashkent probably late Feb 2023 (typo). Bukhara restart 14 Mar 2023 accepted, Nukus by 8 Apr 2023 (543 km in ~25 days is plausible).

claims.value: 'The pandemic also set in around this time' (context: 2018)

conflicts.assessment: S6 is wrong; COVID hit in 2020 while Karl was already off-route waiting in Mexico.

claims.value: Facebook post dated 9 Nov 2024 captioned 'Leaving Baku and headed west'
Left Baku 10 Nov 2024 (official site, seen only via search-engine summary)

conflicts.assessment: Post dated 9 Nov may have been made the evening before or on departure; 9–10 Nov range used. Could not fetch karlbushby.world directly (Vercel bot checkpoint / HTTP 429).
Probably entered 5 Feb; photo taken 6 Feb. Range kept.

claims.value: Reached Istanbul 25 Apr 2025 (official site via search summary)
Arrived Üsküdar (AA report pub. 30 Apr 2025; photo caption 'April 28')

conflicts.assessment: Arrival between 25 and 30 Apr 2025; Explorersweb's phrasing may be stale. Exact day unresolved.
Wikipedia cites the 11 Jun 2025 BBC article for 'Armenia', but that BBC article says 'currently in Mexico waiting for a visa'. Treat Armenia as a Wikipedia error.

claims.value: Plan (Feb 2025): Istanbul then 'go to Greece via Edirne'
Actual: exited via Kapıkule into Bulgaria, 1 Sep 2025

conflicts.assessment: Plan changed; Bulgaria is the confirmed route.

claims.value: In Slovakia, 'possibly already near Bratislava' (speculative; last record Komárom)
Reached Győr, Hungary before Christmas, a few days from the Austrian border; to resume near HU–AT border

conflicts.assessment: BBC is based on Bushby's own statement; noviny.sk was speculative and Komárom is on the Hungarian bank. Wikipedia's 'December 2025 in Slovakia' derives from noviny.sk. Prefer Győr/Hungary; Slovakia unconfirmed.

claims.value: approximately four days of swimming and resting

conflicts.assessment: Primary-quoted figure is 20 h over three days; 'four days' likely includes start/rest. Start date therefore ~2–3 Oct 2026, unconfirmed.
Single source (Wikipedia); the NoTélé article it cites does not state this date. Loncke (19 Sep) said 'will enter France soon'. Plausible but unverified.

claims.value: Interview 'two days' after swim; 'Tomorrow, he'll start the walk home' → ~8 Oct
Final leg starting from Dover on Oct. 9

conflicts.assessment: 8 or 9 Oct 2026; Guardian timing is approximate (published 13 Oct, interview date implied).

claims.value: Near Market Rasen, Lincs, Wed 28 Oct, 'about 30 miles from the finish line'
Sat 31 Oct 'travelling near Barton in South Cambridgeshire, with about 130 miles left to go' (spokesperson; ITV / Brit Brief)

conflicts.assessment: Incompatible: walking 130 miles in ~2 days is not credible at his stated 20–25 km/day, and Market Rasen is north of Cambridgeshire. Likely garbled (possibly Barton-upon-Humber, at the south end of the Humber Bridge, and/or '13 miles'), but this is speculation — not plotted. Needs the original ITV text. Update 2026-11-03: BBC reports he crossed the Humber Bridge on Sun 1 Nov (S43), so being near Barton-upon-Humber (south end of the bridge) on 31 Oct is plausible — still not plotted without the original ITV text.

claims.value: Arrived Mon 2 Nov 2026 (City Hall, then mother's house)
Getty photo caption: 'arrived home on Sunday'

conflicts.assessment: CONFIRMED: arrived Mon 2 Nov 2026 (AP, Reuters/Al Jazeera; ESPN body text). ESPN's Getty caption saying Sunday contradicts its own article and the agency reports; he crossed the Humber Bridge on Sunday 1 Nov (BBC), which may explain the caption. Earlier dates were plans.

claims.value: Official finish = family/childhood home (north of City Hall); QVS is the civic welcome
'his mother's house at Queen Victoria Square' (garbled)

conflicts.assessment: Hull City Council and BBC are clear: the finish is his mother's home on the Sutton Park estate.

conflicts.topic: Departure from Hull in 1998 (context for anniversary claims)

claims.value: Left Hull 5 Oct 1998 → Channel landfall 5 Oct 2026 'precisely 28 years'
'On 1 November 1998, Bushby set off from his mother's house' then flew to Chile

conflicts.assessment: Out of scope for this leg but affects the '28 years to the day' narrative; flag for Leg 01.

Road numbers for Punta Arenas->border, Rio Gallegos->Piedra Buena, Piedra Buena->Gobernador Gregores, Tecka->Esquel, El Bolson->Chile pass, Antofagasta->Iquique coastal stretch, Loja->Quito are not given in sources.

Route Srednekolymsk -> Sasyr (via Zyryanka?) and where spring 2015 ended; whether there was a later 2015 season.

Route and dates Neryungri -> Tynda? -> Erofey Pavlovich/Mogocha and any winter 2016/17 break.
Route to the Mongolian border (Chita? Ulan-Ude? Kyakhta?) and the crossing point/date in 2017.

COVID: no COVID pause falls in this leg.

Karl's solo route across southern/western Mongolia in early 2018 and the Mongolia→China crossing point.

Kazakhstan 2018–19 route east of Almaty and Kazakhstan→Uzbekistan crossing point.
Uzbekistan→Turkmenistan and Turkmenistan→Iran border posts.
Named roads for Bukhara–Nukus–Beyneu–Shetpe (A380/A27 likely but unsourced).

Whether he crossed Stara Planina / Vidin–Calafat bridge as planned; date of Bulgaria→Romania crossing
